September 10, 2026

**Geographic focus:**

**Temporal focus:**
T1. Historical report [NO]
T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [YES]
T3. Forward-looking reporting long-term risks (next quarters/years) [YES]

**Synopsis:**
Oil prices above $100/bbl (driven by Iran-US shipping conflict in the Middle East) are reigniting global inflation pressure and pushing bond yields higher, including 10-year Treasuries to multi-year highs. The dollar is underperforming its traditional safe-haven role due to debasement concerns, fiscal pressures, and global central bank tightening. The ECB is set to hike rates again the same day. The BoJ is expected to hike to 1.25% on Sept 18 and 1.75% in Q2 2027. US PPI (Thursday) and CPI (Friday) are the key near-term data points ahead of the Sept 15-16 FOMC. Markets are pricing ~60% probability of a Fed rate hike this month following a strong NFP print.
